title: My Family
description: A girl talks about the people in her family.
instructions: Read the text about a family, then choose the best answer (A, B, C or D) for each question.

paragraphs.text: My name is Lily and I am eight years old. I live in a small house with my family. There are five people in my family.
My dad is a cook. He makes very good soup. My mum is a nurse at the hospital. She helps sick people every day.
I have one brother and one sister. My brother, Sam, is ten. My sister, Rosa, is a baby. On Sundays, we all eat dinner together.
My brother Sam likes football. He plays every day after school. He is in a team at our school. Sometimes he plays with me in the garden. He is a good brother, but he is very noisy!
My sister Rosa is only one year old. She cannot walk yet. She has big brown eyes and very little hair. She laughs when I sing to her. I love her very much.
My grandparents live in a house near the sea. They do not live with us. We visit them every summer. My grandpa has a small boat. He takes us out on the sea and we catch fish for dinner.
On Sundays, my dad cooks a big dinner. He makes soup, chicken and rice. My mum makes the salad and I help her. After dinner, we play a game together. I love Sundays with my family.
